title: Chapter 291 The Enemy No Longer Has A Safe Rear Area
content:
Chapter 291 The Enemy No Longer Has A Safe Rear Area

The only shortcoming of the Zerg Devourer is its slow attack speed, which is much slower than the speed of the Zerg Dragons in spraying biological bombs.

"Puff...Puff...!"

A thousand five-star Zerg Devourers launched a second round of attacks. Their super strong killing power and auxiliary attack capabilities immediately solved the crisis for the Zerg Dragons.

The killing effect of the Zerg Dragons, which are also five-star in strength, is completely incomparable to that of the Zerg Devourer.

Under the precise command of the Queen, after each round of attack, the thousand five-star Zerg Devourers not only killed a large number of flying soldiers of the alien race, but also greatly reduced the casualties of the Zerg Dragons, helping the Zerg Dragons and the Zerg anti-aircraft soldiers on the ground to quickly kill the enemy.

"The Zerg flying troops are too powerful! As soon as they joined the battle, they immediately turned the tide of the air battle!"

"Have you noticed that in the areas they attacked, the alien flying troops that were not directly attacked were all in a bad state!"

"Yes, those alien flying troops that seemed to be unharmed were all waiting to die, and were easily killed by other Zerg troops!"

"I don't know if this situation is caused by the ability of those new troops or other hidden means of the Zerg!"

"Once this happens, it may be some means of the Zerg. If it happens every time, it must be the ability of those new troops!"

"The Zerg doesn't have to... It is meaningless to use other means to cooperate with a new soldier type in combat!"

"With the support of these powerful new soldiers, the Zerg will not have a big problem in air combat!"

"After each round of their attack, tens of thousands of alien flying soldiers disappear. No matter how many flying soldiers the aliens have, they are not enough to fight!"

"This is the strongest flying soldier type I have ever seen!"

"It is really a group of air overlords!"

"I am really looking forward to the performance of another new soldier type of the Zerg!"

"..."

The spectators from all forces in the local camp were impressed by the powerful air combat capabilities of the Zerg Devourers and were looking forward to the performance of the Zerg Air Guards.

A thousand five-star Zerg Air Guards flew into the air defense area of the Zerg main combat unit and stopped.

Based on the real-time intelligence provided by the Zerg host, they launched a covering attack on the powerful ground troops area in the attacking alien army that even the five-star Zerg destroyers could not hit.

The five-star Zerg Sky Guard ejected a large mass of unknown matter, flew towards the target area at a very high speed, and fell into the target group at high speed.

"Bang Bang Bang...!"

Compared to the explosion of the Zerg Destroyer's liquid fireball shells, a hybrid explosion that had never been seen before exploded.

The indescribable terrible explosion swept across a large area. The elite troops of the alien race, which the five-star Zerg Destroyer could not hit, suffered heavy losses in an instant, and almost all of them were killed or wounded.

The explosion of a thousand hybrid shells destroyed the strongest troops of the alien race's ground forces at once.

This hybrid explosion has a much stronger coverage and lethality than the explosion of the Zerg Destroyer's liquid fireball shells.

"Bang Bang Bang...!"

The attack speed of the five-star Zerg Sky Guard is comparable to that of the five-star Zerg Dragon, and much faster than that of the five-star Zerg Devourer.

After several rounds of attacks, the backbone of the alien race's ground forces was destroyed.

After losing those core forces, the ground forces of the alien army weakened their offensive, which greatly reduced the defensive pressure of the Zerg army.

Wu Qing saw that in the 996 cities of the aliens, more and more ultra-long-range siege equipment were constantly launching ultra-long-range attacks. They played a huge role in this war.

By the way, the best app for reading and listening to books at present, Yeguo Reading, install the latest version.

The ultra-long-range siege equipment of the aliens killed a large number of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, tied down the air defense forces of the vast majority of Zerg main combat forces, and killed a lot of Zerg main combat arms.

If there were no attacks from these ultra-long-range siege equipment, the situation on the battlefield would change immediately.

The positions of the ultra-long-range siege equipment of the aliens are protected by powerful light-attribute energy defense shields, which cannot be broken even by the attacks of five-star Zerg destroyers.

"This type of energy shield is difficult to break with explosive and scattered attacks. Let the air guards give it a try!"

Wu Qing is going to use a five-star air guard to try and see if he can break the light-attribute energy shield of the alien race. As long as the energy shield is broken, the siege equipment inside will be vulnerable.

The five-star air guard has an attack range beyond visual range, which is much farther than the Zerg destroyer. If it flies higher, it can almost attack all areas of the 996 cities of the alien race.

They want to attack the ultra-long-range siege equipment of the alien race, and the range is not a problem at all.

The Zerg air guard has two attack modes. The covering attack mode just used has stronger attack power than the Zerg destroyer, but the attack method is similar. It is estimated that it is difficult to break the light-attribute energy shield of the alien race.

The explosive attack of the covering attack mode is still too scattered.

One thousand five-star Zerg air guards have switched to the single-point attack mode. This attack mode has extremely strong single-point lethality, and the penetration of power should also be good.

Wu Qing wanted to use this attack, which could kill enemies with six-star strength, to try to hit the light attribute energy defense shield of the Tianwai Human Race.

"Peng Peng Peng...!"

The attack of the five-star Zerg Air Guard in the single-point attack mode does not look much different from the attack in the coverage mode, except that the mixed material shells sprayed are obviously smaller, more refined, and faster.

The flying speed of the mixed material cannonball is already comparable to the speed of the cannon of technological civilization, and the traces are no longer visible to the naked eye.

"Boom boom boom...!"

There were waves of terrible cracking sounds.

The light attribute energy defense shield that the five-star Zerg destroyers of the Tianwai human race could not break through was broken by the single-point attack mode of the five-star Zerg aerial guards!

Under the command of the Queen of Insects, the five-star Zerg Destroyers who were already on standby immediately launched an attack on the ultra-long-range siege equipment positions of the Outer Terrans whose defense cover had been broken.

"Rumble...!"

In the fierce explosion, the precious ultra-long-range siege equipment of the Tianwai Human Race was shattered into debris on the ground.

"Peng Peng Peng...!"

A thousand five-star Zerg air guards continued to attack, one by one breaking through the powerful light attribute energy defense shield in the 996 City of the Human Race outside the sky.

Fifteen thousand five-star Zerg Destroyers followed closely behind, quickly covering the key defensive areas of the Tianwai Human Army with fierce firepower.

The two powerful Zerg ultra-long-range attack units cooperated, and in a short period of time, they destroyed all the Tianwai human ultra-long-range siege equipment within the range of the five-star Zerg Destroyer.

This caused the attacking army of the Tianwai Terrans to lose their most important ultra-long-range fire support, and the offensive weakened again.

Fifteen thousand five-star Zerg Destroyers returned their firepower to the frontline battlefield, destroying a large number of the attacking Tianwai human army.

A thousand five-star Zerg aerial destroyers slowly flew high, condescendingly, based on the latest intelligence on the battlefield, and under the precise command of the Zerg Queen, using beyond-visual-range shooting to support the battlefields of all parties.

In those 996 cities of the Tianwai Human Race, some of the Ultra-long-range siege equipment of the Tianwai Human Race that are outside the range of the Zerg Destroyer are also within their attack range, and their single point attack mode and coverage attack mode are switched between each other one by one. wreck.

They are high up, with powerful firepower covering attack mode, and can support any battlefield position on the ground and in the air.

"This new unit of the Zerg tribe turns out to be a super unit that is even stronger than the ultra-long-range attack unit!"

"It can provide a wide range of fire support, and can also carry out super single-target killing of powerful targets. With this new unit, the Zerg army has almost no shortcomings in ultra-long-range attacks!"

"The defensive shield that the Tianwai Terran's ultra-long-range siege equipment relies on has finally been broken! If they don't have a new way to deal with it, the Zerg will win this battle again!"

"It's hard to say. The Tianwai Terran army is very strong. As long as reinforcements continue, it will be difficult for the Zerg to win!"

"The strength of the two powerful units newly reinforced by the Zerg is still too small. As long as there are enough armies from the outer world, we can still fight!"

"That makes sense. It depends on which of the two tribes is more willing to invest!"

"..."

The spectators from all the forces in the local camp saw the power of the two ultimate arms of the Zerg. Some people believed that the Zerg had turned the tide of the war and would turn defeat into victory. Others believed that the outer human race still had strength left, and it was not certain who would win or lose.

People who hold both views have good vision. The Zerg used two new arms to successfully turn the tide of the war. However, as long as the Tianwai Terrans do not give up, it will still not be easy for the Zerg to win this war.

After losing their ultra-long-range siege equipment, the Tianwai Terrans can only rely on the combat power and military strength advantages of ordinary armies to make up for their disadvantages in ultra-long-range attacks and air combat.

Except for the addition of 2,000 powerful new troops, the Zerg army has not changed other armies. The Tianwai Terrans can still fight again.

Under the continuous reinforcements of the Outer Worlds, a thousand five-star Zerg Air Guards and a thousand five-star Zerg Devourers, apart from allowing the Zerg army to eliminate more effective forces of the Outer People, they were unable to continue to expand the Zerg. The military's battlefield advantage.

A thousand five-star Zerg Devourers, in cooperation with the Zerg flying dragons, slaughtered various flying units of the outer human race to their heart's content.

A large number of parasitic light griffins and other flying units controlled by three thousand Zerg Queens also participated in the battle, and they were all performing the most dangerous combat missions.

A thousand five-star Zerg air guards left the 996th city of the outer human race with no safe rear area.
